b9bc186d7d62062ba51a9d7690aa0aceff639762.summary: A 2018 security blog tutorial explaining how unquoted Windows service paths can be abused for local privilege escalation. It describes the general technique only and names no threat actor, campaign, malware, CVE, sector, country, or incident, so it is not a threat report.

b9b204ee5c8f664fe7d38868781eca75ede5d767.summary: This is a Snort intrusion-detection rule reference page for alert 1:26941, a MALWARE-CNC rule that fires on a download by a Win.Trojan.PipCreat RAT dropper. It gives a generic description of command-and-control alerts and standard rule boilerplate. Most sections read 'No information provided' or 'No public information', and it contains no threat analysis, attribution, or campaign detail.
